resources.string: Cannot start navigation: select a restaurant with a valid name and location.
Waiting for your location. Make sure location is turned on.
Allow precise location to get directions and distance.
Could not get your location. Check location settings and try again.
Finding a pedestrian route… The arrow appears after the walking path is ready.
Walking route loaded. Walking directions are in beta and may miss sidewalks or pedestrian paths. Use caution.
Walking route unavailable. The arrow is hidden. Retry to request a pedestrian route.
Add your Google Maps Platform API key in Settings to load walking routes. The arrow stays hidden until a walking route is available.
Could not read this app\'s signing identity. Open Settings and Help to check API key setup. The arrow stays hidden until a walking route is available.
Google rejected the route request. Check Routes API, billing, and your API key setup in Settings and Help. The arrow stays hidden until a walking route is available.

Google rejected your API key. Check that Routes API and billing are enabled and that key restrictions match this installed app. Open Settings and Help. The arrow stays hidden until a walking route is available.
Google Routes quota or rate limit reached. Check your project\'s quotas and billing, then retry. The arrow stays hidden until a walking route is available.
Google Maps could not find a walking route here. The arrow stays hidden until a walking route is available.
Could not connect to Google Routes. Check your internet connection and retry. The arrow stays hidden until a walking route is available.
Allow camera access and precise location to use camera navigation.
Camera preview unavailable. Retry camera navigation.
Location is off. Turn it on to resume navigation.
Waiting for a fresh GPS fix accurate to 25 m or better. The arrow stays hidden until your location is reliable.
Hold the phone toward the path and move it slowly to calibrate the compass. The arrow appears with fresh camera, compass, and GPS data.
Waiting for a live camera preview. The arrow stays hidden until new camera frames arrive.
%1$d m remaining on the walking path
You are off the walking route
The arrow is hidden to avoid misleading directions. Find a new walking route from your current location.
You have reached the end of the mapped walking path. Check your surroundings for the restaurant entrance.
The walking path could not be verified. The arrow is hidden. Find a new route from your current location.
